— Web design & development

Responsive website design

Plan clear page layouts and navigation around the information your customers need.

Ask about this service

What this work addresses

Design begins with page purpose and user journeys. A visitor should be able to understand the offer, find relevant detail, and reach a next step on a phone as well as a desktop. Visual consistency supports that task; decorative complexity can make it harder.

How I approach it

I define page hierarchy, key layouts, content needs, and interaction behavior before implementation. Designs consider readable line lengths, contrast, keyboard focus, touch targets, and realistic content. Reusable patterns keep the finished site coherent as pages are added.

Potential deliverables

  • Information architecture
  • Responsive page layouts
  • Interaction and accessibility specifications

Important considerations

Design quality depends on accurate content and real testing. A visual layout alone does not establish accessibility or conversion performance. Photography, specialist illustration, identity design, and formal research are included only when explicitly agreed.

Preparing for a discussion

Share your current setup, the business outcome you want, and any known constraints. We can then define the useful boundaries of the work, required access, and how the agreed deliverables will be checked. Implementation and ongoing support are included only when agreed.

Common scope questions

Is implementation included?+

The scope may cover a review, recommendations, implementation, or a combination. We agree responsibilities and deliverables before starting so you know what is included in this responsive website design engagement.

Where does this fit in a wider plan?+

This is one part of web design & development. The right starting point depends on the current setup and the business goal. Related work is recommended only where it addresses a practical dependency.
